Ruth, I couldn't set up the daily brief. The scheduler refused the job because the Gateway needs credentials, and I didn't change any config to get around that.

I also couldn't check whether a "Strategic pod brief" job already exists, for the same reason. So please don't assume one is running yet.

Here is what I'd set up once the scheduler works:

- **Schedule:** every day at 07:45 America/Chicago, starting Thu 2026-10-15. I've assumed Chicago time because that's your time zone. Tell me if you meant UTC.
- **Where:** posted in #strategic-random as one message.
- **Content:** new messages from the last day in #strategic-pod, #strategic-random and #inc-vtg-hartford.
- **Guardrails:**
  - A channel is only included if everyone in #strategic-random is also in it. Right now that holds for all three (Gideon, Nadia and you).
  - Money terms and finance documents are left out. Seat counts, dates, products, ticket numbers and meeting times stay in.
  - Direct messages are never included.

To finish, someone with Gateway admin access needs to set up the Gateway credentials, or I can ask the openclaw setup tool to look into it. Once the scheduler works, I'll create the job and run one test. I'll post the test brief here so you can check it.
